scope: Recorded finite organizer-image instruction counts for the three-arm anchor schedule, not a production execution or a proof of collision probabilities. The base and new kernels differ only in the schedule dispatch and the skipped anchor load/compare.
environment: curvesma-reference-count (gcc Debian 14.2.0-19, valgrind 3.24.0, linux/arm64); -O3 -fno-tree-vectorize -mgeneral-regs-only -static; inputs are fixed-seed uniform field elements, one input file per batch size shared by both builds.

checks.dump_check: the B=65536, one-round walk dumps are byte-identical between base and new builds

schedule: rounds t with t mod 64 = 0 are anchor rounds; 1 <= t mod 64 <= 32 are skip rounds (plain tail without `ldr x6` and `ccmp`); 33 <= t mod 64 <= 63 are plain rounds.
